# Aurex SDK — LLM & AI Coding Agent Integration Guide (/llms.txt)

> Aurex (`aurex-sdk` on PyPI and npm) is an open-source, in-process Python & TypeScript LLM FinOps and runtime guardrail SDK. It wraps existing OpenAI, Anthropic, Google GenAI, LiteLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face, and OpenAI-compatible (Groq, Together, Fireworks, OpenRouter) clients with `<0.1 ms` overhead, zero proxy hops, and Zero-PII local SHA-256 hashing.

## 1. Golden Rules for Integrating Aurex into an Existing Codebase

1. **Initialize once per process:** Create `AurexAuditor` once at startup (e.g., FastAPI `lifespan`, Django `AppConfig.ready()`, Express bootstrap, or Next.js `instrumentation.ts`) and call `patch_all(auditor)` (Python) or `await auditor.patchAll()` (Node.js).
2. **Bundled TypeScript apps (Next.js Turbopack / Webpack / Vite / Vitest):** Also call `auditor.instrument(OpenAI, Anthropic, GoogleGenAI, Ollama)` (passing imported SDK constructors or client instances) so bundler-isolated prototypes are instrumented deterministically.
3. **Pass `workflow_id` / `workflowId` directly on LLM calls:** Aurex automatically strips `workflow_id`, `workflowId`, `tags`, `tenant_id`, `tenantId`, `quality_score`, and `qualityScore` before requests hit provider HTTP endpoints (preventing `HTTP 400` errors) and sanitizes Anthropic `metadata` to `{ user_id }`. If omitted, Aurex falls back to `aurex_context` / `aurexContext` -> active OpenTelemetry `trace_id` -> `AUREX_WORKFLOW_ID`.
4. **Record real task completion:** Call `auditor.mark_success(workflow_id)` / `auditor.markSuccess(workflowId)` (or `mark_failure` / `markFailure`) when the business workflow completes so Stage 3 computes true `cost_per_success` rather than cost per LLM turn.
5. **Flush in short-lived scripts & serverless functions:** Call `auditor.flush()` / `auditor.flush_async()` (Python) or `auditor.flush()` / `await auditor.flushAndWait()` (Node.js) before Lambda/CLI exit. Use `storage_mode="memory"` / `storageMode: "memory"` on read-only container filesystems.
6. **Naming convention:** Python uses `snake_case` (`max_cost_per_session`, `enable_loop_guard`, `strict_provider_drift`). Node.js uses `camelCase` (`maxCostPerSession`, `enableLoopGuard`, `strictProviderDrift`).
7. **Multi-agent context & retry libraries (`tenacity` / LangGraph / SWE-agent):** Wrap multi-agent graph runs with `aurex_context.set({"workflow_id": run_id})` (Python) or `aurexContext.run({ workflowId }, ...)` (Node.js) so sub-agents do not fall back to `default_workflow`. Never retry `AurexBlocked` in external retry decorators (e.g., use `retry=retry_if_not_exception_type(AurexBlocked)` in `tenacity`).

## 2. Drop-In Python Integration (FastAPI / Async / Sync / `.parse()` / `.stream()` / `Responses`)

```python
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI
from aurex_sdk import AurexAuditor, AurexBlocked, AurexBudgetExceeded, AurexConfig, patch_all

auditor = AurexAuditor(
    AurexConfig(
        redis_url=None,  # Or "redis://localhost:6379/0" (also reads env AUREX_REDIS_URL)
        enable_loop_guard=True,
        budget_guard={
            "max_cost_per_session": 1.50,
            "max_cost_per_minute": 15.00,
            "max_context_tokens": 195000,
            "max_thinking_tokens": 4096,
            "on_budget_exceeded": "throw",  # "warn" | "throw" | "webhook"
        },
        resilience={"enabled": True, "mode": "enforce", "max_attempts": 2},
    )
)
patch_all(auditor)

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    yield
    auditor.flush()

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
```

## 3. Drop-In TypeScript / Node.js Integration (Next.js / Express / Fastify)

```typescript
import { AurexAuditor, AurexBlocked } from "aurex-sdk";
import OpenAI from "openai";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

export const auditor = AurexAuditor.getInstance({
  redisUrl: process.env.AUREX_REDIS_URL,
  enableLoopGuard: true,
  budgetGuard: {
    maxCostPerSession: 1.5,
    maxCostPerMinute: 15.0,
    maxContextTokens: 195000,
    maxThinkingTokens: 4096,
    onBudgetExceeded: "throw",
  },
  resilience: { enabled: true, mode: "enforce", maxAttempts: 2 },
});

await auditor.patchAll();
auditor.instrument(OpenAI, Anthropic);
```

## 4. Supported SDK Methods & Provider Nuances

- **OpenAI (`openai`):** Sync & Async `chat.completions.create`, `chat.completions.parse` (Pydantic/Zod), `chat.completions.stream`, `responses.create`, `responses.parse`, `responses.stream`. Auto-injects `stream_options={"include_usage": True}`. Automatically detects `base_url` / `baseURL` for **Groq**, **Together AI**, **Fireworks**, **OpenRouter**, **Bedrock**, and **Ollama** (`localhost` = `$0.00`, hosted cloud = real token rates).
- **Anthropic (`anthropic` / `@anthropic-ai/sdk`):** Sync & Async `messages.create`, `messages.parse`, `messages.stream`. Inspects `cache_control` block arrays, tracks mixed `5m` (`1.25x`) and `1h` (`2.0x`) cache writes, separates `ThinkingBlock` from `TextBlock`, and enforces the `>200k` 2x cliff on Claude 4+ models.
- **Google Gemini (`google-genai` / `@google/genai`):** `models.generate_content` & `models.generate_content_stream` (sync & `.aio` async), `thoughts_token_count`, `cached_content_token_count`, and `>200k` 2x cliff on Gemini 2.5+ models.
- **LiteLLM, Ollama & Hugging Face:** `litellm.completion` / `acompletion`, `ollama.Client` / `AsyncClient`, `huggingface_hub.InferenceClient`.

## 5. Exceptions, Health & CI Commands

- **Exceptions:** `AurexBlocked` (pre-call budget/loop/policy block), `AurexBudgetExceeded` (post-call budget breach), `AurexResilienceExhausted` (all retries/fallbacks failed), `AurexProviderDriftError` (raised when `strict_provider_drift=True` or `AUREX_STRICT_DRIFT=1` detects an incompatible upstream SDK layout change).
- **Health check:** `auditor.get_health()` (Python) / `auditor.getHealth()` (Node.js) returns `status`, `events_logged`/`eventsLogged`, `patch_status`/`patchStatus`, and `drift_warnings`/`driftWarnings`.
- **CLI & CI:**
  - `aurex audit`
  - `aurex ci --ledger .aurex/ledger.jsonl --baseline main_ledger.jsonl --github-comment --fail-on-regression`
  - `aurex install-hook` (zero-code Python `.pth` / Node `--import` hook; activate with `AUREX_ENABLED=1`)

## 6. Documentation Routes

- `/docs` — 3-stage pipeline overview & 60-second quickstart
- `/docs/installation` — Python & Node installation, serverless flush, and zero-code hook
- `/docs/stage-1-shield` — Prefix Cache-Shield & `200k` 2x cliff guard
- `/docs/stage-2-breaker` — Session-isolated spend, thinking caps, Redis state, and stream breaker
- `/docs/stage-3-outcomes` — `mark_success()`, HTTP-200 soft-failure gate, tenant policies, and `aurex ci`
- `/docs/reference` — Complete `AurexConfig`, `BudgetGuard`, provider coverage, and env vars
